network_note: Device-side disable is only half the story. The matching network-side block (telemetry domains, e.g. dm.wo.com.cn for SystemHelper) already lives in Lowex proxy rules - OPPO 34 / Xiaomi 41 domains, v1.7.25 - and only applies while the proxy is on. This module does the device side; Lowex does the network side. Neither can stop on-device recording itself - that needs ADB disabling on the phone, and without root it cannot be fully blocked.
note: Curated telemetry / upload components for Chinese OEM ROMs. Huawei is intentionally excluded per user request. Every entry is opt-in and disabled only via pm disable-user --user 0. Disabling can break the named feature - read breaks_what before ticking. Sources: Lowex vendor-privacy lists (OPPO 34 domains / Xiaomi 41 domains, v1.7.25), user-verified SystemHelper behaviour, and public package documentation. Unverified claims are marked as such - do not treat them as proven.
